verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any user-configurable background automations, such as scheduled jobs, watchers, recurring tasks, or agent-driven workflows. Automatic embedding generation on indexing and serverless autoscaling are built-in system behaviors, not automations a user sets up. The community remark about paid alerts is a pricing complaint that does not describe the capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
